Mind Breaking is a a few degrees of separation from the Objectification Kink, both having roots in sex and having the sub only be used for sex. Usually masochism is either a prerequisite or is a symptoms of Mind Breaking. After getting Mind Broken, usually the effects can be suppressed somehow if the sub or dom wants the sub to be out in polite society. entries.name: mind-control
entries.content: Mind Control or Hypnotism/Hypnosis is the act of temporarily taking control of another's mind, supplanting their will with one hypnotiser's own. Mind Control can happen in a number of different ways, either self-inflicted—intentionally or unintentionally—or inflicted by someone else. One can have their Mind Controlled in a number of different ways: pendant, pendulum, stop-watch, magic, potions, spirals, and/or subconscious conditioning. Mind Control is a good way of getting someone to do what they don't want to, like sex or prostitution. Mind Control and Mind Breaking go hand in hand—Mind Control being a temporary way of supplanting will and Mind Breaking being more permanent. Usually, the trance can be broken by a keyword, like "awaken," or with an action preformed by the hypnotiser, like snapping ones fingers, or, if the one who hypnotized someone didn't give them any order, they will eventually faint and wake up with no memories of what happened while being hypnotized,
